verdictRationale: Outcome 'automated_success' indicates compliance requirement is satisfied

registryEntry.label: Antivirus Signature Currency via Intune
registryEntry.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations').value | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.defenderSignatureUpdateIntervalInHours } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ displayName = $_.displayName; id = $_.id; defenderSignatureUpdateIntervalInHours = $_.defenderSignatureUpdateIntervalInHours } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
evidence_commands: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations').value | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.defenderSignatureUpdateIntervalInHours } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ displayName = $_.displayName; id = $_.id; odataType = $_.'@odata.type'; defenderSignatureUpdateIntervalInHours = $_.defenderSignatureUpdateIntervalInHours; lastModifiedDateTime = $_.lastModifiedDateTime } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
